concepts.name: Taproot
concepts.idea: A sprout whose root is the soil probe: leaves above the ground line, the blue sensor blade below it.

concepts.name: Needle
concepts.idea: A moisture dial sunk in the ground, dry to wet; the needle is a sprout parked in the good band.

concepts.name: Fork
concepts.idea: An F/H ligature drawn as the two-prong soil probe, with a water drop held between the prongs.
